connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Connect your brand's social channels and websites. Publish and schedule content directly from Contivo.

noWorkspace.title: Create a workspace first
noWorkspace.body: Connections belong to a workspace — it decides which brand's content gets published. Create one under Workspaces, then come back.

connectResult.foreign: Nothing was connected: this link was started from another Contivo account. If you didn't start it, ignore it. To connect your own account, use the Connect Account button below.
connectResult.failed: The connection didn't finish or has expired. Nothing was connected. Try again.

modal.title: Connect a Social Account

platforms.linkedinDescription: Publish text posts and articles to your <bdi>LinkedIn</bdi> profile or company page.
platforms.xDescription: Post tweets and threads to your <bdi>X</bdi> account.
platforms.facebookDescription: Publish posts and link shares to a <bdi>Facebook</bdi> Page you manage.
platforms.tiktokDescription: Publish photo carousel posts and videos to your <bdi>TikTok</bdi> account.
platforms.telegramDescription: Post to a <bdi>Telegram</bdi> channel or group you manage.

modal.unavailableTitle: {platform} has no API credentials on this deployment.
modal.unavailableDescription: Not set up on this deployment — no API credentials yet.
modal.instagramNote: Coming in Phase 2 — requires media pipeline.
modal.securityNote: Your access token is encrypted and stored securely. It is never exposed to the frontend. You can revoke access at any time.

accounts.title: Connected Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Manage your linked social media accounts.
accounts.emptyBody: Connect <bdi>LinkedIn</bdi>, <bdi>X</bdi>, or <bdi>Facebook</bdi> to start publishing directly from <bdi>Contivo</bdi>.
accounts.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this account? Published content will remain on the platform.

statusHint.expired: Your <bdi>{platform}</bdi> sign-in has expired. Posts to this account will fail until you reconnect.
statusHint.revoked: Access to this <bdi>{platform}</bdi> account was withdrawn. Reconnect to publish to it again.
statusHint.pendingReauth: <bdi>{platform}</bdi> needs you to sign in again before <bdi>Contivo</bdi> can publish.
statusHint.failed: The connection to <bdi>{platform}</bdi> stopped working. Reconnect to publish to it again.
statusHint.unsupported: This <bdi>{platform}</bdi> connection stopped working, and it cannot be reconnected from this page yet.
statusHint.telegramBotRemoved: The Contivo bot was removed from this channel, so posts to it will fail. Reconnect to add the bot back.
statusHint.telegramBotRightsLost: The Contivo bot lost its right to post in this channel, so posts to it will fail. Reconnect to give the right back.

errors.setDefault: Could not make this the default account.

rules.title: Publish Rules
rules.subtitle: Default behaviors applied to every publishing action in this workspace.
rules.hashtagsDescription: Automatically append relevant hashtags based on content topic.
rules.formatterDescription: Adjust formatting and character limits per platform before publishing.
rules.crossPostingDescription: Automatically post to multiple platforms at once. Available in Phase 2.
rules.note: Settings are saved per workspace. Individual post settings override these defaults.

queue.title: Publish Queue
queue.subtitle: Scheduled and in-progress posts. Published and cancelled jobs appear in History.
queue.emptyBody: When you schedule content to publish, it will appear here.

history.title: Publish History
history.subtitle: All completed publish attempts — published, failed, or cancelled.
history.emptyBody: Published and failed posts will appear here.

sites.noWorkspaceBody: Create a workspace first — a site connection serves the content of one workspace.
sites.title: Websites
sites.subtitle: Give a site an API key and it can pull its published posts from <bdi>Contivo</bdi>. Works with any stack — the site fetches, <bdi>Contivo</bdi> never pushes into your codebase.
sites.fieldRevalidateUrlHint: Called after each publish so your site can clear its cache.
sites.fieldRevalidateSecretHint: Sent as a Bearer token to that URL.
sites.secretPlaceholder: a random string your site checks
sites.emptyBody: Add a site to give it an API key. Autopilot can then write for the blog channel and your site will serve the posts.
sites.actionRotate: Issue a new key (invalidates the current one)
sites.keyBody: Copy it now — this is the only time it is shown. <bdi>Contivo</bdi> stores only a hash, so it cannot be shown again. Lost it? Rotate to issue a new one.
sites.keyStore: Store the key as CONTIVO_API_KEY on your site — server-side only.

telegram.openTitle: Open the Contivo bot in Telegram
telegram.openBody: Tap Start in the chat that opens. This page moves to the next step by itself.
telegram.waitingStart: Waiting for you to tap Start…
telegram.chooseBody: In Telegram, tap “Choose a channel” and pick your channel. Contivo’s bot is added as an admin that can only post messages.
telegram.waitingChoice: Waiting for your choice in Telegram…
telegram.usernameLink: My channel is public and the bot is already admin
telegram.usernameBody: Make the Contivo bot an admin with the right to post messages, then enter the channel’s public username.
telegram.codeBody: Enter the 6-digit code the bot sent you in Telegram.
telegram.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
telegram.expiredBody: A connect link works for a few minutes only. Start again to get a new one.

errors.bot_not_admin: The Contivo bot cannot post there yet. Make it an admin with the right to post messages, then choose the channel again.
errors.user_not_admin: Your Telegram account must be an admin who can post in that channel.
errors.chat_not_found: Telegram found no public channel or group with that username, or the bot is not in it.
errors.not_a_channel_or_group: That is not a channel or a group. Choose a channel or a group.
errors.telegram_unavailable: Telegram did not answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.too_many_attempts: The code was entered wrong too many times. Start again to get a new one.
errors.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the latest message from the bot.
errors.not_pending: No channel is waiting for a code yet. Choose your channel in Telegram first.
errors.start_bot_first: Open Telegram and tap Start in the bot first.
errors.invalid_username: Enter the channel’s public username, the one that starts with @.
errors.session_not_found: This connect link has expired. Start again.
errors.telegram_not_configured: Telegram is not switched on for Contivo yet.
errors.store_unavailable: Connecting is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.session_expired: Your Contivo session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this workspace.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the publishing service. Try again in a minute.
errors.api_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.
